blocks.text: Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0 introduced a modernized version of the app that provides users with clear status and actionable, natural-language guidance, while keeping technical details within easy reach if they need to engage Zscaler Support. You can use this setting to determine which version of the app is the default for users. The default value is enabled.
To learn more, see Using Zscaler Client Connector in the Modern UI.

This setting affects only users with Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0 and later. Users with earlier versions can view only the Classic UI version of the app. You can also configure the default UI experience per app profile. Contact Zscaler Support to enable this feature.
To configure the default UI experience:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > OS.
On the Platform Settings tab, click Edit.
In the Edit Platform Settings window, under General Settings, set the Default to Modern Client UI Experience option:
Enabled: Users with Zscaler Client Connector version 5.0 and later view the Modern UI version of the app.
Disabled: All users view the Classic UI version of the app (the same UI included with earlier versions).
